mapper.select: select * from fulfillment_orders where order_id = #{orderId} order by fulfillment_id asc
mapper.insert: insert into fulfillment_orders (fulfillment_no, shop_id, order_id, warehouse_code, fulfillment_status, allocation_reason, estimated_ship_at, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{fulfillmentNo}, #{shopId}, #{orderId}, #{warehouseCode}, #{fulfillmentStatus}, #{allocationReason}, #{estimatedShipAt}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.update: update fulfillment_orders set fulfillment_status = 'SHIPPED', actual_ship_at = sysdate(), update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where fulfillment_id = #{fulfillmentId} and fulfillment_status = 'PACKED'

update fulfillment_orders set fulfillment_status = 'DELIVERED', completed_at = sysdate(), update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where fulfillment_id = #{fulfillmentId} and fulfillment_status = 'SHIPPED'
